tools.name: list
tools.description: What one company's published subprocessor list says, as this record holds it: every row quoted as the company wrote it, with the purpose and location it printed, when the row was first and last seen here, the source page and the date it was read. Says so when no list for that company has been read.

tools.name: named_by
tools.description: Which companies name one subprocessor on their published lists, with the name each company prints for it, when it was first seen on that list and when the list was read. One subprocessor per call. Free to read, cite and link. Every row is a dated quote of a company's own published page: cite the pag

tools.name: changes
tools.description: The dated changes to one company's list, each derived from two readings of that list and carrying both. A change is what the page said on one date against what it said on another; it is never a claim about when a company began or ended a relationship. `printed_differently` marks an entry the list pr

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: What company a name on a list refers to, through this record's hand-checked identity table. Exact match only, never a guess: an unknown name comes back unresolved, which is an answer. Free to read, cite and link. Every row is a dated quote of a company's own published page: cite the page and the rea

tools.name: check
tools.description: Given the companies a reader buys from, which of their own published lists name one company, or a company headquartered in a country, on their latest version: in the list's own words, with when it was first seen here and the day the list was checked. Past the first step it answers in counts only: ho

tools.name: as_of
tools.description: What one company's list said on a given date, from the reading this record holds nearest before it, with that reading's own date, its web-archive capture where there is one, its source and its digest. Says so when the date is earlier than the first reading held. Needs a key on an account with Follow

tools.name: in_chain
tools.description: Given the companies a reader buys from, every path from that list to one company, or to a country: named directly, or named on the own list of a company they name (a fourth party, or sub-subprocessor). Each step is a list's own row, with its purpose and location as written, and the versions each run

tools.name: changes_across
tools.description: The dated changes to the lists of several companies at once, each carrying the two readings it came from. The same facts as `changes`, gathered for one reader's own list of companies. Needs a key on an account with Follow your vendors running: this is part of the subscription on disclosedby.com. Fre

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "as_of" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
